description: This file defines models and a fetcher for income statement growth data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameters, data structures, and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: FMPIncomeStatementGrowthQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching income statement growth data from FMP API.

classes.name: FMPIncomeStatementGrowthData
classes.description: Represents income statement growth data with alias mappings and descriptive fields.

classes.name: FMPIncomeStatementGrowthFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming income statement growth data from FMP API.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves raw income statement growth data from FMP API endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into list of FMPIncomeStatementGrowthData instances.
